{{Removed|date = 29th of October 2020}} {{For|the [[Armored]]|other uses of [[XR (Disambiguation)|XR]]}} {{UnitInfobox |image-static = ArmoredXR600.png |image-dynamic = ArmoredXR600Dynamic.png |pseudoxd = true |source = [[Mecha Base]] |type = Vehicle (& Humanoid) |spawnrate = [[File:VehicleSpawn.png|20px|Spawnrate]]45s |health = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]250 |damage_type = Single
Collision |ranged_damage = [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]]8 |ranged_firerate = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]]0.45 |ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]32 |speed = 4 |hidden = No }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Armored XR600''' was the second vehicle that spawned from the [[Mecha Base]]. It spawned when the [[Mecha Base]] was at Level 2. As with other units, it started from the end of the map path and moved towards the entrance of the map. The '''Armored XR600''' had a spawnrate of 45 seconds. '''Armored XR600''' could attack enemies with its turret. ==Appearance== '''Armored XR600''', as the name suggets, was an armored versions of the [[XR600]]. It was a blue tracked mech. It had tracks covered by armor. The operator could shoot from its turret. The operator itself had yellow skin, its torso and legs were black, and it wore white goggles. ==Strategy== *'''Armored XR600''' can be useful against hordes of high health enemies like the [[Giant Boss]], [[Chained Boss]] or [[Slow Boss]]. **Due to its long range, it can easily attack enemies from a long distance. *On two-pathed maps, only one '''Armored XR600''' will spawn per Level 2 [[Mecha Base]]. It will go down a random path in some maps, like [[Infernal Abyss]], but may always go down one specific path in other maps, like [[Badlands]]. *The '''Armored XR600''' can deal full collision damage to shielded enemies, like the [[Summoner Boss]] and [[Templar]]. **Even more interestingly, damage from its turrets is not capped, meaning that the '''Armored XR600''' can operate at maximum DPS against these enemies. **However, due to its low health and DPS for the time these appear, it is not recommended to use the '''Armored XR600''' against these enemies. *As with other units, the firerate and range of '''Armored XR600''' cannot be boosted by the [[Commander]] or [[DJ Booth]], respectively. *'''Armored XR600''' cannot be stunned by any enemy, making it very useful against such enemies. **However, such enemies generally only appear on later waves, where the '''Armored XR600''' will not perform well due to its low health and DPS. *While '''Armored XR600''' can collide with [[Hidden]]s and [[Ninja]]s, it cannot detect them. **Do note that because of its low health, the '''Armored XR600''' can be easily destroyed if it collides with multiple of them. ==Trivia== *The goggles worn by the operator inside '''Armored XR600''' are a re-textured version of the the {{RLinkC|833772989|Laser Spec Special Forces Goggles}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. ==Update History== *'''26 January 2020''' - [[Release v1.6|Release v1.6.0]] **'''Armored XR600''' added. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **'''Armored XR600''' removed, replaced by [[Mark II]]. {{TowerNavBox}} [[Category:Exclusive Content]]
